title: Choose a new password
purpose: Use the recovery link to replace the account password.
summary: Choose a new password from your recovery link.

tasks.title: Set the new password
steps: Type it in [[New Password]] and again in [[New Password (again)]].
Select [[Change Password]]. Then sign in with it; you are not signed in automatically.

tasks.title: Get a new link when this one fails
steps: If the page says the link is bad, select [[new password reset]] to ask for another.

good_to_know: Continue in the same browser that opened the link.
A used, invalid or expired link cannot change the password.
Resetting the password does not reset two-factor authentication or laboratory permissions.
Opening another account's link while signed in signs out the current account.
A new password needs at least 15 characters, or 8 if the laboratory requires a second sign-in factor of the account. The form states which.

items.label: New Password
items.description: Required new password. The help under it states the rule for this account: at least 15 characters, or 8 where the laboratory's second sign-in factor rule covers the account, read again when you save. Refused: a common password; a common password (where it has at least four letters) or a name of the laboratory, the application or the account with only digits, symbols, spaces or letter case changed; one character or a text of fewer than 15 characters repeated; a run such as 123456789 or qwertyuiop; a password too similar to the username, names or email address. The whole password is compared, so a passphrase containing a common word is accepted. Letters of any language, digits, symbols and spaces count (the null character is refused), and there is no upper limit or required kind of character. The confirmation must match exactly. Errors keep the form open; password fields may need entering again.

items.label: New Password (again)
items.description: Required identical repeat of the replacement.

items.label: Change Password
items.description: Saves only for a valid, unexpired recovery token. Success opens the password-changed acknowledgement. This deployment does not automatically sign in the account after reset.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: On a valid reset form, cancels the pending stage by signing out and returns to sign-in.

items.label: new password reset
items.description: A Bad Token page has no password form and offers this link to request another reset. Already-used, invalid or expired tokens cannot change the account.

sections.title: Link and session rules
paragraphs: The emailed key is moved into this browser’s session before showing the form; continue in the same browser session. Following another account’s reset link while signed in signs out the current different account. Requesting a link does not reset MFA or laboratory permissions. Password fields are not guaranteed to be preserved after validation errors.
